name: Hidden Chute
source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
description: A trapdoor in the floor conceals a stone chute.
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to remove the trapdoor or lock it in position using a catch hidden inside the room's doorframe

offensiveAbilities.name: Pitfall
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks onto the trapdoor

Effect The triggering creature falls 30 feet down the shaft to area E33, taking 15 bludgeoning damage and landing Prone in the ochre jelly's pit. The creature can Grab an Edge to avoid falling.

The DC to Climb the walls or Grab an Edge is 22.
